cdx_head.text:
# METADATA
# title: Teams should use CycloneDX 1.6 and above to use key features
# description: >-
#   Teams who are generating am SBOM will benefit from using CycloneDX version 1.6 and above in order to access key features that make it much easier to represent certain information, such as multiple CPEs and PURLs. This policy gives informational feedback on the advantages of using version CycloneDX 1.6 and above.
# custom:
#   short_name: CDX_1_6_PLUS
#   severity: tip
package prodsec.policies.cyclonedx.CDX_1_6_PLUS

import data.ec.lib
import data.ec.lib.util.is_cdx
import data.prodsec.util.is_cdx_equal_above_version
import rego.v1

# Define the prerequisites to check for each policy (i.e. what SBOMs should these policies run on?)
prerequisite if {
	is_cdx
}


_policy_id := "CDX_1_6_PLUS"

spdx_head.text:
# METADATA
# title: Teams should use SPDX 2.3 and above to use key features
# description: >-
#   SPDX counterpart of CDX_1_6_PLUS. SPDX 2.3 is the newest 2.x version and the one the Red Hat SBOM guide and Trustify target.
# custom:
#   short_name: SPDX_2_3_PLUS
#   severity: tip
package prodsec.policies.spdx.SPDX_2_3_PLUS

import data.ec.lib
import data.ec.lib.util.is_spdx
import data.prodsec.spdx_util
import rego.v1

prerequisite if {
	is_spdx
}

_policy_id := "SPDX_2_3_PLUS"

cdx.text:
# METADATA
# title: SBOM is CycloneDX 1.6 and Above
# description: SBOM is CycloneDX 1.6 and above in order to ensure support of potentially important features.
# custom:
#   short_name: cdx_sbom_is_cdx_1_6_and_above
#   failure_msg: The CycloneDX version of this SBOM may not support important features that may be required for complete and accurate manifesting. In order to properly represent multiple PURLs and multiple CPEs of an SBOM, CycloneDX version 1.6 and above is needed.
#   severity: tip
deny contains result if {
	prerequisite
	# violating condition (SBOM is NOT 1.6 and above)
	not is_cdx_equal_above_version("1.6")
	result := object.union(
		lib.result_helper(rego.metadata.chain(), []),
		{ "policy_id": _policy_id },
	)
}

spdx.text:
# METADATA
# title: SBOM is SPDX 2.3 and Above
# description: SBOM is SPDX 2.3 and above in order to ensure support of potentially important features.
# custom:
#   short_name: spdx_sbom_is_spdx_2_3_and_above
#   failure_msg: The SPDX version of this SBOM is older than SPDX-2.3, which may not support important features that may be required for complete and accurate manifesting.
#   severity: tip
deny contains result if {
	prerequisite
	not _is_2_3_or_above
	result := object.union(
		lib.result_helper(rego.metadata.chain(), []),
		{"policy_id": _policy_id},
	)
}

_is_2_3_or_above if semver.compare(spdx_util.spdx_semver, "2.3.0") >= 0

rules.callout: specVersion ≥ 1.6 → spdxVersion ≥ SPDX-2.3: 1.6 added evidence.identity; SPDX-2.3 is the newest 2.x.

cdx_head.text:
# METADATA
# title: CycloneDX SBOM Uses Ancestors Field
# description: >-
#   Using the pedigree.ancestors field of a component inside of a CycloneDX SBOM, teams can denote the upstream of a component in the SBOMs they generate. Supported by Trustify.
# custom:
#   short_name: CDX_ANCESTORS
#   severity: tip
package prodsec.policies.cyclonedx.CDX_ANCESTORS

import data.ec.lib
import data.ec.lib.util.is_cdx
import data.ec.lib.util.reverse_index
import rego.v1

# Define the prerequisites to check for each policy (i.e. what SBOMs should these policies run on?)
prerequisite if {
	is_cdx
}

_policy_id := "CDX_ANCESTORS"

spdx_head.text:
# METADATA
# title: SPDX SBOM Uses Ancestor Relationships
# description: >-
#   SPDX counterpart of CDX_ANCESTORS. CycloneDX nests the upstream of a component in pedigree.ancestors; SPDX 2.3 expresses the same with ANCESTOR_OF / DESCENDANT_OF relationships.
# custom:
#   short_name: SPDX_ANCESTORS
#   severity: tip
package prodsec.policies.spdx.SPDX_ANCESTORS

import data.ec.lib
import data.ec.lib.util.is_spdx
import data.prodsec.spdx_util
import rego.v1

prerequisite if {
	is_spdx
}

_policy_id := "SPDX_ANCESTORS"

cdx.text:
# METADATA
# title: Ancestors Field is Used in CycloneDX SBOM
# description: In a given CycloneDX SBOM, there are components where the pedigree.ancestors relationship is utilized.
# custom:
#   short_name: cdx_ancestors_field_is_used
#   failure_msg: TIP == In this SBOM, the pedigree.ancestors relationships have not been utilized. This field can denote the upstream of a component. This field is supported for Trustify SBOM ingestion.
#   severity: tip
deny contains result if {
	prerequisite
	# violating condition of the policy (no ancestor components found in the sbom)
	count(ancestor_components) == 0
	result := object.union(
		lib.result_helper(rego.metadata.chain(), []),
		{ "policy_id": _policy_id },
	)
}

ancestor_components contains result if {
	prerequisite	
	some path, value
	walk(input.components, [path, value])
	is_number(reverse_index(path, 1))
	value["bom-ref"]
	path[count(path) - 2] == "ancestors"
	result := value["bom-ref"]
}

spdx.text:
# METADATA
# title: Ancestor Relationships are Used in SPDX SBOM
# description: In a given SPDX SBOM, there are ANCESTOR_OF or DESCENDANT_OF relationships.
# custom:
#   short_name: spdx_ancestor_relationships_are_used
#   failure_msg: TIP == In this SBOM, ANCESTOR_OF / DESCENDANT_OF relationships have not been utilized. They can denote the upstream of a package.
#   severity: tip
deny contains result if {
	prerequisite
	count(spdx_util.relationships_of_type({"ANCESTOR_OF", "DESCENDANT_OF"})) == 0
	result := object.union(
		lib.result_helper(rego.metadata.chain(), []),
		{"policy_id": _policy_id},
	)
}

cdx_head.text:
# METADATA
# title: CycloneDX SBOM has a Main CPE
# description: >-
#   An SBOM can have a CPE field that ties it a product.
# custom:
#   short_name: CDX_CPE
#   severity: tip
package prodsec.policies.cyclonedx.CDX_CPE

import data.ec.lib
import data.ec.lib.util.is_cdx
import rego.v1

# Define the prerequisites to check for each policy (i.e. what SBOMs should these policies run on?)
prerequisite if {
	is_cdx
}


_policy_id := "CDX_CPE"

spdx_head.text:
# METADATA
# title: SPDX SBOM has a Main CPE
# description: >-
#   SPDX counterpart of CDX_CPE. SPDX has no .metadata.component.cpe; a CPE is a SECURITY externalRef (cpe22Type / cpe23Type) on the described package.
# custom:
#   short_name: SPDX_CPE
#   severity: tip
package prodsec.policies.spdx.SPDX_CPE

import data.ec.lib
import data.ec.lib.util.is_spdx
import data.prodsec.spdx_util
import rego.v1

prerequisite if {
	is_spdx
}

_policy_id := "SPDX_CPE"

cdx.text:
# METADATA
# title: CycloneDX SBOM Has CPE
# description: The main component of a CycloneDX SBOM has a CPE.
# custom:
#   short_name: cdx_main_component_has_cpe
#   failure_msg: TIP == If this a product-level SBOM, it is advised to define a CPE in .metadata.component.cpe field to directly tie it to that product. If this is a component-level SBOM please disregard this tip.
#   severity: tip
deny contains result if {
	# violating condition of the policy
	prerequisite
	not input.metadata.component.cpe
	result := object.union(
		lib.result_helper(rego.metadata.chain(), []),
		{ "policy_id": _policy_id },
	)
}

spdx.text:
# METADATA
# title: SPDX SBOM Has CPE
# description: A package the SPDX document describes has a CPE externalRef.
# custom:
#   short_name: spdx_main_package_has_cpe
#   failure_msg: TIP == If this a product-level SBOM, it is advised to define a CPE externalRef (cpe22Type or cpe23Type) on the described package to directly tie it to that product. If this is a component-level SBOM please disregard this tip.
#   severity: tip
deny contains result if {
	prerequisite
	count([p | some p in spdx_util.described_packages; count(spdx_util.refs_of_type(p, spdx_util.cpe_types)) > 0]) == 0
	result := object.union(
		lib.result_helper(rego.metadata.chain(), []),
		{"policy_id": _policy_id},
	)
}

rules.callout: metadata.component.cpe: SPDX has no main-component CPE field; CPE is a cpe22Type/cpe23Type externalRef on a described package.

cdx_head.text:
# METADATA
# title: CycloneDX SBOM Makes Valid External References to other SBOMs
# description: >-
#   When teams produce an SBOM for their product, they will most likely NOT be putting all transitive layers into a single SBOM. This policy would ensure that the references to external SBOMs made are defined using the correct fields and are syntactically correct. Making sure that these references are correctly written is crucial for the relationships to accurately make it into TPA.
# custom:
#   short_name: CDX_EXTERNALREFS
#   severity: error
package prodsec.policies.cyclonedx.CDX_EXTERNALREFS

import data.ec.lib
import data.ec.lib.util.is_cdx
import data.prodsec.util.is_cdx_equal_above_version
import data.ec.lib.util.reverse_index
import rego.v1

# Define the prerequisites to check for each policy (i.e. what SBOMs should these policies run on?)
prerequisite if {
	is_cdx
}

_policy_id := "CDX_EXTERNALREFS"

spdx_head.text:
# METADATA
# title: SPDX SBOM Makes Valid External References to other SBOMs
# description: >-
#   SPDX counterpart of CDX_EXTERNALREFS. CycloneDX references other SBOMs from components (Bomlink urn:cdx: or a bom URL); SPDX 2.3 declares them once in externalDocumentRefs (DocumentRef- ID, spdxDocument URI, SHA1 checksum).
# custom:
#   short_name: SPDX_EXTERNALREFS
#   severity: error
package prodsec.policies.spdx.SPDX_EXTERNALREFS

import data.ec.lib
import data.ec.lib.util.is_spdx
import rego.v1

prerequisite if {
	is_spdx
}

_policy_id := "SPDX_EXTERNALREFS"

_doc_refs := object.get(input, "externalDocumentRefs", [])

cdx.text:
# METADATA
# title: All Bomlink SBOM References are Valid
# description: Given an SBOM, ensure that all Bomlink external references to other SBOMs are valid in format.
# custom:
#   short_name: cdx_all_sbom_exrefs_valid_bomlink
#   failure_msg: An invalid Bomlink external reference to an SBOM has been found in component purls %s
#   severity: error
deny contains result if {
	prerequisite
	is_cdx_equal_above_version("1.5") # additional prerequisite for this rule since bomlink support starts from v1.5
	# violating condition (Bomlink badly defined)
	count(component_bomrefs_with_invalid_bomlink_references) > 0
	result := object.union(
		lib.result_helper(rego.metadata.chain(), [component_bomrefs_with_invalid_bomlink_references]),
		{ "policy_id": _policy_id },
	)
}

component_bomrefs_with_invalid_bomlink_references contains result if {
	some i,j
	external_ref := components_with_bom_references[i]["externalReferences"][j]
	# since bom-link and bom-uri use the same space to define relation, avoid http linkages for checking bom-link
	not startswith(external_ref["url"], "http")
	not regex.match(`^urn:cdx:[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}/[1-9][0-9]*$`, external_ref["url"])
	result := components_with_external_references[i]["bom-ref"]
}

spdx.text:
# METADATA
# title: All External Document References are Valid
# description: Given an SBOM, ensure that every externalDocumentRefs entry has a valid DocumentRef- ID and a SHA1 checksum.
# custom:
#   short_name: spdx_all_sbom_exrefs_valid_documentref
#   failure_msg: An invalid external document reference has been found for externalDocumentIds %s
#   severity: error
deny contains result if {
	prerequisite
	count(_invalid_ids) > 0
	result := object.union(
		lib.result_helper(rego.metadata.chain(), [_invalid_ids]),
		{"policy_id": _policy_id},
	)
}

_invalid_ids contains object.get(ref, "externalDocumentId", "") if {
	some ref in _doc_refs
	not _valid(ref)
}

_valid(ref) if {
	regex.match(`^DocumentRef-[A-Za-z0-9.\-]+$`, ref.externalDocumentId)
	ref.checksum.algorithm == "SHA1"
	regex.match(`^[0-9a-f]{40}$`, ref.checksum.checksumValue)
}

rules.callout: externalReferences[type=bom] urn:cdx: Bomlink: SPDX declares other SBOMs in externalDocumentRefs (DocumentRef- ID + SHA1 checksum); no 1.5-style version gate.

cdx.text:
# METADATA
# title: All Bom uri SBOM References Have Non-empty URL Fields
# description: Given an SBOM, ensure that all SBOM external references to other SBOMs done using the bom uri field are non-empty in format.
# custom:
#   short_name: cdx_all_sbom_exrefs_nonempty_bomuri
#   failure_msg: An empty bom uri external reference to an SBOM has been found in component purls %s
#   severity: error
deny contains result if {
	prerequisite
	count(component_bomrefs_with_empty_bom_uri_references) > 0
	result := object.union(
		lib.result_helper(rego.metadata.chain(), [component_bomrefs_with_empty_bom_uri_references]),
		{ "policy_id": _policy_id },
	)
}

component_bomrefs_with_empty_bom_uri_references contains result if {
	some i,j
	external_ref := components_with_bom_references[i]["externalReferences"][j]
	external_ref["url"] == ""
	result := components_with_external_references[i]["bom-ref"]
}

spdx.text:
# METADATA
# title: All External Document References Have Non-empty spdxDocument Fields
# description: Given an SBOM, ensure that every externalDocumentRefs entry has a non-empty spdxDocument URI.
# custom:
#   short_name: spdx_all_sbom_exrefs_nonempty_spdxdocument
#   failure_msg: An empty spdxDocument has been found for externalDocumentIds %s
#   severity: error
deny contains result if {
	prerequisite
	count(_empty_ids) > 0
	result := object.union(
		lib.result_helper(rego.metadata.chain(), [_empty_ids]),
		{"policy_id": _policy_id},
	)
}

_empty_ids contains object.get(ref, "externalDocumentId", "") if {
	some ref in _doc_refs
	object.get(ref, "spdxDocument", "") == ""
}

cdx.text:
# METADATA
# title: External SBOM References Used
# description: Given an SBOM, there have been external references identified.
# custom:
#   short_name: cdx_sbom_exrefs_used
#   failure_msg: TIP == No external SBOM references have been found in this SBOM. Referencing other SBOMs are possible with the bom uri field, or using the Bomlink method if SBOM is CycloneDX 1.5 or higher.
#   severity: tip

	result := object.union(

components_with_bom_references contains result if {

components_with_external_references contains result if {

	value["externalReferences"]
	result := value
}

spdx.text:

deny contains result if {

	result := object.union(

cdx_head.text:
# METADATA
# title: CDX_MAINCOMPONENTDUP
# description: >-
#   ProdSec use-cases policy 1. Check if top component is duplicated into the components array in a CycloneDX SBOM.
# custom:
#   short_name: CDX_MAINCOMPONENTDUP
#   severity: error
package prodsec.policies.cyclonedx.CDX_MAINCOMPONENTDUP

import data.ec.lib
import data.ec.lib.util.is_cdx
import rego.v1

# Define the prerequisites to check for each policy (i.e. what SBOMs should these policies run on?)
prerequisite if {
	is_cdx
}

_policy_id := "CDX_MAINCOMPONENTDUP"

spdx_head.text:
# METADATA
# title: SPDX_MAINPACKAGE
# description: >-
#   SPDX counterpart of CDX_MAINCOMPONENTDUP. SPDX has no separate .metadata.component to duplicate; the described package must itself be present in packages[].
# custom:
#   short_name: SPDX_MAINPACKAGE
#   severity: error
package prodsec.policies.spdx.SPDX_MAINPACKAGE

import data.ec.lib
import data.ec.lib.util.is_spdx
import data.prodsec.spdx_util
import rego.v1

prerequisite if {
	is_spdx
}

_policy_id := "SPDX_MAINPACKAGE"

cdx.text:
# METADATA
# title: Has top purl in components
# description: Check if the .metadata.component has been duplicated into the components[] array
# custom:
#   short_name: cdx_top_purl_in_components
#   failure_msg: CycloneDX SBOM top-purl does not have a duplicate in the components array for top-purl '%s'
#   severity: error
deny contains result if {
	prerequisite
	top_purl := input.metadata.component.purl
	every component in input.components {
		component.purl != top_purl
	}
	result := object.union(
		lib.result_helper(rego.metadata.chain(), [top_purl]),
		{ "policy_id": _policy_id },
	)
}

spdx.text:
# METADATA
# title: Described package is in packages
# description: Every SPDX ID the document describes is a package in packages[].
# custom:
#   short_name: spdx_described_package_in_packages
#   failure_msg: SPDX SBOM describes '%s', which is not in the packages array
#   severity: error
deny contains result if {
	prerequisite
	some id in spdx_util.described_ids
	not startswith(id, "DocumentRef-")
	count([p | some p in object.get(input, "packages", []); p.SPDXID == id]) == 0
	result := object.union(
		lib.result_helper(rego.metadata.chain(), [id]),
		{"policy_id": _policy_id},
	)
}

rules.callout: metadata.component duplicated in components[]: SPDX has no separate main component; the described package must itself be in packages[].

cdx_rules.text:
# METADATA
# title: Has top purl in components
# description: Check if the .metadata.component has been duplicated into the components[] array
# custom:
#   short_name: cdx_top_purl_in_components
#   failure_msg: CycloneDX SBOM top-purl does not have a duplicate in the components array for top-purl '%s'
#   severity: error
deny contains result if {
	prerequisite
	top_purl := input.metadata.component.purl
	every component in input.components {
		component.purl != top_purl
	}
	result := object.union(
		lib.result_helper(rego.metadata.chain(), [top_purl]),
		{ "policy_id": _policy_id },
	)
}

cdx_head.text:
# METADATA
# title: CycloneDX SBOM Contains Multiple CPEs
# description: >-
#   A CycloneDX SBOM that is version 1.6 and above has the ability to represent multiple CPEs using the metadata.component.cpe field for the main CPE, and the metadata.component.evidence.identity field for its aliases.
# custom:
#   short_name: CDX_MULTICPE
#   severity: tip
package prodsec.policies.cyclonedx.CDX_MULTICPE

import data.ec.lib
import data.ec.lib.util.is_cdx
import data.prodsec.util.is_cdx_equal_above_version
import data.ec.lib.util.reverse_index
import rego.v1

# Define the prerequisites to check for each policy (i.e. what SBOMs should these policies run on?)
prerequisite if {
	is_cdx
    is_cdx_equal_above_version("1.6")
    input.metadata.component.cpe
}

_policy_id := "CDX_MULTICPE"

spdx_head.text:
# METADATA
# title: SPDX SBOM Contains Multiple CPEs
# description: >-
#   SPDX counterpart of CDX_MULTICPE. CycloneDX 1.6 lists CPE aliases in metadata.component.evidence.identity; SPDX lists every CPE as its own externalRef on the described package.
# custom:
#   short_name: SPDX_MULTICPE
#   severity: tip
package prodsec.policies.spdx.SPDX_MULTICPE

import data.ec.lib
import data.ec.lib.util.is_spdx
import data.prodsec.spdx_util
import rego.v1

prerequisite if {
	is_spdx
	# same gate as the CycloneDX rule's 1.6 (where evidence.identity was added)
	semver.compare(spdx_util.spdx_semver, "2.3.0") >= 0
	some p in spdx_util.described_packages
	count(spdx_util.refs_of_type(p, spdx_util.cpe_types)) > 0
}

_policy_id := "SPDX_MULTICPE"

spdx.text:
# METADATA
# title: SPDX SBOM Uses Multi-CPE
# description: A package the SPDX document describes has more than one CPE externalRef.
# custom:
#   short_name: spdx_contains_multicpe_example
#   failure_msg: TIP == This SBOM includes a main CPE. SPDX can represent CPE aliases by adding one externalRef per CPE to the described package. This is supported for Trustify SBOM ingestion.
#   severity: tip
deny contains result if {
	prerequisite
	count([p | some p in spdx_util.described_packages; count(spdx_util.refs_of_type(p, spdx_util.cpe_types)) > 1]) == 0
	example_snippet := {"externalRefs": [
		{"referenceCategory": "SECURITY", "referenceType": "cpe22Type", "referenceLocator": "main_cpe_here"},
		{"referenceCategory": "SECURITY", "referenceType": "cpe22Type", "referenceLocator": "cpe_alias_here"},
	]}
	result := object.union(
		lib.result_helper(rego.metadata.chain(), []),
		{"policy_id": _policy_id, "multi_cpe_example": example_snippet},
	)
}

rules.callout: metadata.component.evidence.identity[field=cpe]: SPDX has no evidence.identity; aliases are extra CPE externalRefs.

package prodsec.policies.spdx.SPDX_PROVIDES

import data.ec.lib

prerequisite if {

cdx.text:
# METADATA
# title: Provides Field is Used in CycloneDX SBOM
# description: In a given CycloneDX SBOM, the provides relationship is utilized.
# custom:
#   short_name: cdx_provides_field_is_used
#   failure_msg: TIP == In this SBOM, the provides relationships have not been utilized. This field can be used to specify what specification a certain component implements. If SBOM is to be ingested by Trustify, the provides field is used to specify source-to-binary relationships.

components_using_provides contains result if {

	input.dependencies[i].provides
	result := input.dependencies[i].ref
}

spdx.text:

# METADATA
# title: Specify the SBOM Type in CycloneDX
# description: >-
#   Teams who are generating an SBOM should define the type of SBOM it is. This can be done using the .metadata.lifecycles field. This policy ensures that different policies can be applied to different SBOM types. This also gives Mequal the option the opportunity to do SBOM evaluation in specific specialized contexts in the future.
# custom:
#   short_name: CDX_SBOMTYPE
#   severity: warning
package prodsec.policies.cyclonedx.CDX_SBOMTYPE

import data.ec.lib
import data.ec.lib.util.is_cdx
import rego.v1

# Define the prerequisites to check for each policy (i.e. what SBOMs should these policies run on?)
prerequisite if {
	is_cdx
}


_policy_id := "CDX_SBOMTYPE"

spdx_head.text:
# METADATA
# title: Specify the SBOM Type in SPDX
# description: >-
#   SPDX counterpart of CDX_SBOMTYPE. SPDX 2.3 has no field for the SBOM type (CycloneDX .metadata.lifecycles; SPDX 3.0 software_sbomType), so this checks creationInfo.comment for "SBOM type: <CISA type>".
# custom:
#   short_name: SPDX_SBOMTYPE
#   severity: warning
package prodsec.policies.spdx.SPDX_SBOMTYPE

import data.ec.lib
import data.ec.lib.util.is_spdx
import rego.v1

prerequisite if {
	is_spdx
}

_policy_id := "SPDX_SBOMTYPE"

cdx.text:
# METADATA
# title: CycloneDX Metadata.lifecycles Field Exists
# description: In a CycloneDX SBOM, the .metadata.lifecycles field exists.
# custom:
#   short_name: cdx_metadata_lifecycles_exists
#   failure_msg: The .metadata.lifecycles field has not been found in this SBOM. Defining an SBOM type helps Mequal evaluate SBOMs in different specialized contexts in the future.
#   severity: warning
deny contains result if {
	prerequisite
	not input.metadata.lifecycles
	result := object.union(
		lib.result_helper(rego.metadata.chain(), []),
		{ "policy_id": _policy_id },
	)
}

spdx.text:
# METADATA
# title: SPDX creationInfo.comment Declares the SBOM Type
# description: In an SPDX SBOM, creationInfo.comment contains "SBOM type:" followed by a CISA SBOM type (design, source, build, analyzed, deployed, runtime).
# custom:
#   short_name: spdx_creationinfo_sbom_type_exists
#   failure_msg: No "SBOM type:" declaration has been found in creationInfo.comment. Defining an SBOM type helps Mequal evaluate SBOMs in different specialized contexts in the future.
#   severity: warning
deny contains result if {
	prerequisite
	not regex.match(`(?i)\bsbom type:\s*(design|source|build|analyzed|deployed|runtime)\b`, object.get(object.get(input, "creationInfo", {}), "comment", ""))
	result := object.union(
		lib.result_helper(rego.metadata.chain(), []),
		{"policy_id": _policy_id},
	)
}

rules.callout: metadata.lifecycles: SPDX 2.3 has no SBOM type field (SPDX 3.0 software_sbomType); checked as "SBOM type: <CISA type>" in creationInfo.comment.

#   severity: tip
package prodsec.policies.cyclonedx.CDX_VARIANTS

import data.ec.lib
import data.ec.lib.util.is_cdx
import data.ec.lib.util.reverse_index
import rego.v1

prerequisite if {
	is_cdx
}

# METADATA
# title: SPDX SBOM Uses Variant Relationships
# description: >-
#   SPDX counterpart of CDX_VARIANTS. CycloneDX nests architecture variants in pedigree.variants; SPDX 2.3 expresses the same with VARIANT_OF relationships.
# custom:
#   short_name: SPDX_VARIANTS
#   severity: tip
package prodsec.policies.spdx.SPDX_VARIANTS

import data.ec.lib
import data.ec.lib.util.is_spdx
import data.prodsec.spdx_util
import rego.v1

prerequisite if {
	is_spdx
}

_policy_id := "SPDX_VARIANTS"

cdx.text:
# METADATA
# title: Variants Field is Used in CycloneDX SBOM
# description: In a given CycloneDX SBOM, there are components where the pedigree.variants relationship is utilized.
# custom:
#   short_name: cdx_variants_field_is_used
#   failure_msg: TIP == In this SBOM, the pedigree.variants relationships have not been utilized. This field can represent the relationship of the image index container to their respective architectural variants in the CycloneDX SBOMs they generate. This field is supported for Trustify SBOM ingestion.
#   severity: tip
deny contains result if {
	prerequisite
	count(variant_components) == 0
	result := object.union(
		lib.result_helper(rego.metadata.chain(), []),
		{ "policy_id": _policy_id },
	)
}

variant_components contains result if {
	prerequisite	
	some path, value
	walk(input.components, [path, value])
	is_number(reverse_index(path, 1))
	value["bom-ref"]
	path[count(path) - 2] == "variants"
	result := value["bom-ref"]
}
